transport: official Agent SDK 0.3.322 streaming input; Claude Code CLI 2.1.319

probe.purpose: Read the context window that the CLI reports for each model of the model list, with no model request.
method: Read the model list with supportedModels().
For each model, start one SDK query with that model and no user prompt.
Call getContextUsage({ detail: 'summary' }) and read maxTokens and rawMaxTokens. The reader uses the smaller valid value.
probe.environment: The first-party child environment of the plugin with DISABLE_COMPACT=1 and settings autoCompactEnabled false, precomputeCompactionEnabled false, idleCompaction false.

observations: maxTokens and rawMaxTokens were equal for each model in a separate run of the same controls.
The alias sonnet reported model claude-sonnet-5-5 in a separate run of the same controls.
One read with the model as a query option took about 0.25 seconds.
A setModel control request for an explicit model id took 0.7 to 2.2 seconds. The reader does not call setModel.
limits: The value is the window that the CLI states. It is not a provider acceptance test at that size.
No network capture recorded the probe. The statement that the summary report sends no model request comes from the SDK declaration text and from the absent user prompt.
The values apply to this account, this plan, and this CLI version.
The probe did not run inside dsh. The dsh token meter and the dsh threshold with these values are not measured.
